books.title: Where Two Worlds Meet
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: A novel about ten-year-old Dill, who moves with his grieving parents to his grandmother's country cottage after his sister dies. Learning to talk with the animals of the valley, he comes to understand the cycles of life and death and helps bring his family back to life.

books.title: The Healing Spirits Oracle
books.author: Gordon Smith
books.description: A deck of 48 cards with a guidebook, its messages presented as guidance from different levels of the spirit world. It is meant for questions about life purpose, fear, inner healing and spiritual growth.
